stat: Estimated number of UK workers routinely using AI tools their employer hasn't sanctioned (shadow AI)
method: Recipe B (population extrapolation from a survey rate applied to an ONS aggregate)

sources_used.title: British workers spend nearly £1bn of their own money on GenAI for work (GenAI Workforce Survey)

workings: Deloitte's GenAI Workforce Survey (n=25,000 UK workers, fieldwork 7 May-10 June 2026) found 63% of UK workers knowingly use GenAI for work, and 31% of those users do so without their employer's knowledge (shadow AI). Combined shadow-AI usage rate across all UK workers: 0.63 x 0.31 = 0.1953 (19.53%, rounded to 19.5%). Applied to ONS's UK employment total of 34.48 million people in work (May-July 2026, from the September 2026 Labour Market Overview): 34,480,000 x 0.1953 = 6,733,344, rounded down conservatively to 6.7 million. Assumes Deloitte's usage rate, measured among UK workers aged 18-70, applies uniformly across the ONS employment total; not adjusted for sector or occupation mix.
